# ifc_models

Open IFC building models, each with its own licence and credit (table below). `<model>_<level>.pdf` and
`.svg` floor plans were rendered by us from `<model>.ifc` with IfcOpenShell (geometry unchanged, title
block and scale bar added); they carry the licence of their model.

- Duplex and Medical-Dental Clinic (buildingSMART): published under CC BY 4.0 today and under CC BY-ND 3.0
  originally. We apply the stricter CC BY-ND 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/3.0/): the
  files are unchanged and no drawings were rendered from them.
- KIT models: "for unrestricted use", source to cite: Institute for Automation and Applied Informatics
  (IAI) / Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT).
- MIT models (DigitalHub, RWTH Aachen; Chesapeake Bay Bridge-Tunnel, buildingSMART Community; ResBIM,
  Xing Liang), with the copyright lines in the table:
